This should make you angry. The Trump administration's cruel ICE detention of his desperate parents delayed their final goodbye and robbed this family of precious time. This heartless cruelty is not who we are as Americans. 

op: @aaronparnas

Video

The Supreme Court may have issued a decision. It’s time for us to again make history.

Video

This Iran disaster is what happens when the Trump administration drags America into reckless foreign entanglements. Our soldiers are paying the ultimate price, while working families get crushed by skyrocketing gas prices at the pump.

They promised to lower costs and keep us out of endless wars. Instead, yet costs are up and we’re stuck in another foreign quagmire

We need to stop this war now.

Video

The Trump administration is censoring federal data on climate, public health, hunger, maternal mortality & more—just because it doesn't fit their narrative. We can't govern on ignorance. Truth matters. Science matters. The American people deserve transparency, not erasure.

op:@interval_news

Video

The Trump administration is saying that  “credit card spending being through the roof” is a sign that working Americans are getting ahead.

To them and their mega-donors, it’s a good thing when families are borrowing to put food on the table and gas in the tank as costs soar out of control.

This is wrong. The American people deserve so much better—an end to these crushing costs, this corruption, and this chaos.

op: @matteo_il_pazzeo

Video

The Supreme Court ruling gutting the Voting Rights Act–is a profound hypocrisy and a heartbreaking step backward for voting rights in America. It strips political power and representation from Black & Brown communities.

The Voting Rights Act is one of the most sacred achievements in our nation’s history.This is fundamentally wrong. We will not go backwards. We will fight forward together.

Video

Thank you @neildegrassetyson

Video

To honor the Mothers of our Democracy - their sacrifice and legacy - we must continue their work.

Video

On this Mother’s Day, we honor the Mothers of the Civil Rights Movement—Fannie Lou Hamer, Amelia Boynton, Ella Baker, and so many more—who bled and sacrificed for the voting rights the Supreme Court has dishonored.

This isn’t about left or right. It’s about who we are as a nation: one committed to fairness, equal representation, and our sacred right to vote.

Video

Throughout this reckless war Trump has refused to lead with transparency and candor, instead issuing contradictory statements, shifting stories, and utter incoherence. Lives are on the line—American troops, innocent civilians, and billions in tax payer dollars are being spent.

We deserve better than this. America deserves better than this. We must end this reckless war now.

During the Civil Rights Movement, even on the bleakest days people rose up from all backgrounds. They overcame intimidation, pain and even the Supreme Court.

The people persevered and that's what we must do now.

Regardless of whether you’re progressive or conservative many of us agree: pouring a trillions into an endless and reckless war in Iran means we’re driving up our debt, robbing our children of healthcare, infrastructure, education, and opportunity. 

op: @harvardkennedyschool

Video

Donald Trump lied to America. Costs are skyrocketing under his leadership. 

On top of a War in Iran and other failed policies skyrocketing costs he also slashed clean energy programs that could lower costs and create jobs. 

Donald Trump is failing America.

op: @taborplace

Video

Here is to beauty, despite all the calamity. Here is to moments that stir the soul and awaken our shared humanity.

Here is to wonder. Here is to surprise. Here is to the small miracles that reopen our eyes.

Here is to laughter that lightens heavy days, To awe and connection in unexpected ways.

And here is to all the things, simple, sacred, and true That remind, us despite the challenges, life is a gift and we are lucky to live it through.

Video

Trump once warned that a President with “no ability to negotiate” would stumble into war with Iran. 

Now his reckless war is driving up gas prices and costing American families more at the pump and the grocery store.

I will keep fighting to stop this war and hold the administration accountable. 

op: @therecount

Video

Because of Trump’s war in Iran, fuel prices are skyrocketing, and American small businesses like these shrimpers are getting hammered at the fuel pump. 

We need leadership that doesn't drag us into endless conflicts making it impossible for working people to provide for their families, we need to redeem the dream for all Americans. 

op: @thewokeginger

Most Americans agree the Supreme Court should not have the weakest ethics laws in the country.

Most Americans – Republican and Democrat – don’t think justices should be able to hold onto their seats forever.

Despite it all “I feel like going on!”

I don't trust this President.

He said he would get us out of wars, he got us in one. He promised to lower prices, now they are skyrocketing.

While he's focused on a ballroom, Americans are paying the price for his war.
